answer: The strongest sybil defense is on-ledger slashing of verifiers who countersign invalid transactions. Each verifier stakes a bond larger than the total epoch reward. A fake identity cannot profit: countersign one fraudulent block and the stake is burned, expelling it from the reef of honest nodes. An attacker posts real capital per identity, like a jetty that collapses when a shipment is faked, while clones multiply losses, like a vine binding each fake to the same ruin. Cost per fake: staked capital plus forgone rewards, exceeding any gain.
